Arriving at.en: reaching a place at the end of a trip

Gaining on.en: getting closer to someone or something you are chasing

Joining with.en: coming together with someone to do something

Stretching toward.en: extending your arm or body in the direction of something

a celebrated.en: famous and praised by many people

a conspicuous.en: very easy to notice; standing out

a contentious.en: causing a lot of disagreement or argument

a fragile.en: weak and easily damaged or lost

a heated.en: full of strong feeling or angry argument

a limited.en: small in amount or importance; restricted

a marginal.en: small and not very important; at the edge

a permanent.en: lasting forever or for a very long time

a prominent.en: important and well known; easy to see

a secure.en: firm and not likely to be lost

a tenuous.en: very weak or slight; easily lost

a visible.en: able to be seen or noticed

acquired.en: got or gained something (past tense of acquire)
acquired.zh: 取得；獲得（acquire 的過去式／過去分詞）

adjust.en: to change something slightly to make it fit or work better

an uncertain.en: not sure or fixed; not clearly known

approached.en: came near to something (past tense of approach)
approached.zh: 接近；靠近（approach 的過去式）

arrived beside.en: came to a place next to something (past tense)

arrived near.en: came to a place close to something (past tense)

caught up to.en: reached someone who was ahead of you (past tense)

caught up with.en: reached the same level or place as someone ahead (past tense)

classified.en: arranged things into groups (past tense of classify)
classified.zh: 分類（classify 的過去式／過去分詞）

collected.en: gathered things together (past tense of collect)
collected.zh: 收集（collect 的過去式／過去分詞）

combined with.en: joined or mixed together with something (past tense)

condense.en: to make something shorter or more compact

decorate.en: to make something look more attractive by adding things to it

decreased.en: became or was made smaller (past tense of decrease)
decreased.zh: 減少；降低（decrease 的過去式／過去分詞）

defend.en: to support an idea or claim with arguments or evidence

derive.en: to get something from a particular source

determined.en: found out or decided exactly (past tense of determine)
determined.zh: 確定；決定（determine 的過去式／過去分詞）

diminished.en: made or became smaller or weaker (past tense of diminish)
diminished.zh: 減少；減弱（diminish 的過去式／過去分詞）

evaluated.en: judged the quality or value of something (past tense of evaluate)
evaluated.zh: 評估（evaluate 的過去式／過去分詞）

expanded.en: made or became larger (past tense of expand)
expanded.zh: 擴大；擴展（expand 的過去式／過去分詞）

extended toward.en: reached or stretched out in the direction of something (past tense)

extract.en: to get information or a substance out of something

gained on.en: got closer to someone being chased (past tense)

hoard.en: to collect and hide a large amount of something

imagine.en: to form a picture or idea in your mind

joined.en: connected or became part of a group (past tense of join)
joined.zh: 加入；連接（join 的過去式）

justify.en: to show that something is reasonable or right

leaned toward.en: bent the body in the direction of something (past tense)

measured.en: found the size or amount of something (past tense of measure)
measured.zh: 測量（measure 的過去式／過去分詞）

muted.en: made a sound or signal quieter or weaker (past tense of mute)
muted.zh: 減弱；使變小聲（mute 的過去式／過去分詞）

obtain.en: to get something, especially through effort

obtained.zh: 獲得；取得（obtain 的過去式／過去分詞）

occupy.en: to fill or use a space or time

overtook.en: went past someone moving in the same direction (past tense of overtake)
overtook.zh: 超越；追過（overtake 的過去式）

reached over to.en: stretched an arm across something to get it (past tense)

reached toward.en: stretched an arm in the direction of something (past tense)

reduced.en: made smaller or less (past tense of reduce)
reduced.zh: 減少；降低（reduce 的過去式／過去分詞）

reserve.en: to keep something for later or for a special purpose

resolved.en: solved a problem or made a decision (past tense of resolve)
resolved.zh: 解決；決定（resolve 的過去式／過去分詞）

revise.en: to change something to improve or correct it

stockpile.en: to collect a large supply of something for future use

stretched toward.en: extended the arm or body in the direction of something (past tense)

substantiate.en: to prove a claim with evidence

summarize.en: to give a short statement of the main points

support.en: to show that a claim is true or reasonable

united with.en: joined together with someone as one group (past tense)

validate.en: to prove that something is true or correct

visited.en: went to see a person or place (past tense of visit)
visited.zh: 拜訪；參觀（visit 的過去式）

weakened.en: made or became less strong (past tense of weaken)
weakened.zh: 減弱；削弱（weaken 的過去式／過去分詞）
